description: LAWRENCE, KS — Chris Mann’s campaign has released its second broadcast television ad of the election cycle. This six-figure buy is running across Kansas and features Neosho County Sheriff Greg Taylor, a lifelong Republican and well-respected leader who has spent the past 28 years serving his community with the Neosho County Sheriff’s Office.
